allocations_file.description: Path to allocations.yaml in repository. Defaults to `config/allocations.yaml`. This file is read-write by the provider with optimistic concurrency control.

base_delay_ms.description: Base delay in milliseconds for exponential backoff. Defaults to `200`.

branch.description: Git branch for IPAM data. Defaults to `main`.

max_retries.description: Maximum retry attempts on conflict. Defaults to `10`.

pools_file.description: Path to pools.yaml in repository. Defaults to `config/pools.yaml`. This file is read-only by the provider; pool definitions are managed via PR.

repository.description: GitHub repository name containing IPAM data files.

token.description: GitHub Personal Access Token or App Installation Token. Can also be set via `GITHUB_TOKEN` environment variable.

block.description:
Git-backed IPAM provider using GitHub API for optimistic concurrency control.

Uses a dual-file architecture:
- **pools.yaml** - Pool definitions (managed via `github-ipam_pool` resource or PR)
- **allocations.yaml** - Allocation state with optimistic concurrency control

This provider enables GitOps-native IP address management without the cost of AWS VPC IPAM.

cidr.description: Allocated CIDR block (computed at apply time).

cidr_mask.description: Prefix length for the allocation (e.g., `16` for /16, `24` for /24).

contiguous_with.description: CIDR of an existing allocation that this block must be immediately adjacent to. If the constraint cannot be satisfied, the plan will fail.

name.description: Human-readable name for this allocation. Can be updated in-place.

parent_cidr.description: CIDR of an existing allocation to sub-allocate from (Mode 2). Use this for allocating subnets within a VPC CIDR. Mutually exclusive with `pool_id`.

pool_id.description: Pool ID from pools.yaml to allocate from (Mode 1). Mutually exclusive with `parent_cidr`.

status.description: Status of the allocation: `allocation` (default) or `reservation`. Reservations hold space for future use.

block.description:
Allocates a CIDR block from an IPAM pool or from an existing allocation.

**Two allocation modes:**
- **Mode 1 (pool_id)**: Allocate from a pool defined in pools.yaml
- **Mode 2 (parent_cidr)**: Sub-allocate from an existing allocation (e.g., subnets within a VPC)

Exactly one of `pool_id` or `parent_cidr` must be specified.

block_size.description: CIDR prefix length for the pool (e.g., `12` for /12, `16` for /16).

name.description: Unique name/identifier for this pool (used as `pool_id` in allocations).

reserved.description: If `true`, this pool is reserved and allocations are not allowed. Reserved pools hold space for future use.

block.description:
Manages an IPAM pool definition in pools.yaml.

Pools are automatically allocated a non-overlapping CIDR block from the specified
private IP range. The provider finds the next available block that doesn't conflict
with existing pools.

**Private Ranges (RFC 1918):**
- `10.0.0.0/8` - Class A (10.0.0.0 - 10.255.255.255)
- `172.16.0.0/12` - Class B (172.16.0.0 - 172.31.255.255)
- `192.168.0.0/16` - Class C (192.168.0.0 - 192.168.255.255)

**Limitation:** Each pool managed through this provider receives a single contiguous
CIDR block. While the underlying pools.yaml format supports multiple non-contiguous
CIDR ranges per pool, this provider only manages single-CIDR pools. For pools with
multiple CIDRs, manage pools.yaml directly outside of Terraform.

**Example:**
```hcl
resource "github-ipam_pool" "stake" {
  name          = "stake"
  private_range = "10.0.0.0/8"
  block_size    = 12
  description   = "Stake product IP pool"
}

# Output: cidr = "10.0.0.0/12" (or next available)
```

id.description: Allocation ID (UUID). Either `id` or `name` must be specified.

name.description: Allocation name. Either `id` or `name` must be specified.

parent_cidr.description: Parent CIDR if this is a sub-allocation.

pool_id.description: The pool this allocation belongs to.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the allocation was created.

parent_cidr.description: The parent CIDR this allocation is carved from.

pool_id.description: The pool ID this allocation belongs to.

allocations.description: List of allocations matching the filter criteria.

parent_cidr.description: Filter allocations by parent CIDR. Mutually exclusive with pool_id.

pool_id.description: Filter allocations by pool ID. Mutually exclusive with parent_cidr.

block.description: Lists allocations from `allocations.yaml`, optionally filtered by `pool_id` or `parent_cidr`.

cidr.description: The next available CIDR block that would be allocated.

cidr_mask.description: The prefix length for the allocation (e.g., 24 for /24).

parent_cidr.description: Parent CIDR to sub-allocate from (Mode 2). Must be an existing allocation.

pool_id.description: Pool ID to allocate from (Mode 1). Mutually exclusive with parent_cidr.

block.description:
Preview the next available CIDR block without allocating it.

This data source is useful for planning and dry-run scenarios. Note that the returned CIDR
is not reserved and may be claimed by another allocation before you use it.

**Important:** Either `pool_id` or `parent_cidr` must be specified, but not both.

cidrs.description: CIDR ranges available in this pool.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata associated with the pool.

pool_id.description: The pool identifier to look up.

block.description: Retrieves details about a specific IP pool defined in `pools.yaml`.

cidrs.description: CIDR ranges available in this pool.

pools.description: List of IP pools defined in `pools.yaml`.

block.description: Lists all IP pools defined in `pools.yaml`. This data source provides a summary of available pools for allocation.
